```javascript
  const criticalDiagnostics = inputDiagnosticsCritical(inputDiagnostics);
```

Ensure that `buildReadback` is robust against missing or malformed properties on `contract` or `validatorResult` (such as `permitted_uses`, `forbidden_uses`, or `checks` not being arrays) by using `Array.isArray` to safely default to empty arrays, preventing unhandled `TypeErrors`.

```javascript
function buildReadback({ contract, validatorResult }) {
  const permittedUses = Array.isArray(contract?.downstream_handoff?.permitted_uses)
    ? contract.downstream_handoff.permitted_uses
    : [];
  const forbiddenUses = Array.isArray(contract?.downstream_handoff?.forbidden_uses)
    ? contract.downstream_handoff.forbidden_uses
    : [];
  const checks = Array.isArray(validatorResult?.checks)
    ? validatorResult.checks
    : [];

  return `# Semantic KG Mastery Signal Candidate Contract Readback

Generated at: \`${contract?.generated_at ?? ''}\`
Issue: #${ISSUE}
Parent: #${PARENT_ISSUE}
Validation status: \`${validatorResult?.summary?.validation_status ?? 'fail'}\`

## Boundary

- Defines \`MasterySignalCandidate\` for future learner-model work only.
- Semantic KG does not create accepted mastery truth or runtime mastery updates.
- Real attempt evidence is required before any future learner model may update mastery.
- Safety states are \`candidate_signal\`, \`provisional_signal\`, \`review_required\`, \`suppressed\`, and \`blocked_quarantined\`.
- No learner model implementation, real student data, runtime mastery scoring, external model/API calls, Supabase mutation, frontend work, or RAG reindex were performed.

## Permitted Downstream Uses

${permittedUses.map((item) => `- ${item}`).join('\n')}

## Forbidden Downstream Uses

${forbiddenUses.map((item) => `- ${item}`).join('\n')}

## Counts

| Metric | Count |
| --- | ---: |
| Represented rows | ${contract?.summary?.represented_row_count ?? 0} |
| Source layer entries | ${contract?.summary?.source_layer_entry_count ?? 0} |
| Source semantic assertions | ${contract?.summary?.source_semantic_assertion_count ?? 0} |
| Source prerequisite candidates | ${contract?.summary?.source_prerequisite_candidate_count ?? 0} |
| Source misconception/attempt-error candidates | ${contract?.summary?.source_misconception_attempt_error_candidate_count ?? 0} |
| Mastery signal candidates | ${contract?.summary?.mastery_signal_candidate_count ?? 0} |
| Candidate signals | ${contract?.summary?.candidate_signal_count ?? 0} |
| Provisional signals | ${contract?.summary?.provisional_signal_count ?? 0} |
| Review-required signals | ${contract?.summary?.review_required_count ?? 0} |
| Suppressed signals | ${contract?.summary?.suppressed_count ?? 0} |
| blocked_quarantined signals | ${contract?.summary?.blocked_quarantined_count ?? 0} |
| Runtime mastery updates | ${contract?.summary?.runtime_mastery_update_count ?? 0} |
| Accepted mastery updates | ${contract?.summary?.accepted_mastery_update_count ?? 0} |
| Safety fixtures | ${contract?.summary?.safety_fixture_count ?? 0} |
| Safety fixture pass/fail | ${contract?.summary?.safety_fixture_pass_count ?? 0}/${contract?.summary?.safety_fixture_fail_count ?? 0} |
| External model calls | ${contract?.summary?.external_model_call_count ?? 0} |

## Artifacts

- Contract: \`${contract?.output_artifacts?.contract ?? ''}\`
- Candidates: \`${contract?.output_artifacts?.candidates ?? ''}\`
- Safety fixtures: \`${contract?.output_artifacts?.safety_fixtures ?? ''}\`
- Safety validator: \`${contract?.output_artifacts?.safety_validator ?? ''}\`
- Readback: \`${contract?.output_artifacts?.readback ?? ''}\`

## Validator Checks

| Check | Status |
| --- | --- |
${checks.map((check) => `| ${check?.id ?? ''} | ${check?.status ?? ''} |`).join('\n')}

## Verification Commands

- \`node scripts/method-map/build-semantic-kg-mastery-signal-contract.mjs --write\`
- \`npm test -- --runInBand --runTestsByPath scripts/method-map/__tests__/semantic-kg-mastery-signal-contract.test.js\`
- \`npm run workflow:codex-preflight -- --json\`
`;
}
```
